# Original site appearance assets

Retrieved on 2026-09-27 to reproduce https://pythontutor.ru/old/ locally:

- `demo_debug_720p.mp4`: https://pythontutor.ru/static/demo_debug_720p.mp4 (original visualizer demonstration; preserve upstream course attribution and CC BY-NC-SA restrictions described in docs/PROVENANCE.md).
- `shoelace.gif`: https://pythontutor.ru/static/shoelace.gif (original task illustration; course attribution and restrictions apply).
- `rubik-one-cyrillic.woff2`: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/rubikone/v23/0nkqC9H5Je0aiyQv-6PIbCTvivz9iTq_.woff2 (Rubik One, SIL Open Font License; see OFL.txt).

Typography, colors and spacing in css/selfhost.css were measured from the rendered original page. Assets are served locally; no Google Fonts or original-site network connection is needed at runtime.
